violations.text: Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (potato slicer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Slicer was placed in 3-bay to be fully cleaned and sanitized. New Violation. Correct By: 10/14/2026

The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher was 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. Dishwasher was observed not dispensing any sanitizer. PIC called to get unit serviced at the time of inspection. Establishment to use 3-bay sink until dishwasher is repaired. New Violation. Correct By: 01/28/2025
